desc.title: About This Tool
desc.p1: Luomor's Tian Zi Ge / Mi Zi Ge practice sheet generator — the go-to writing practice tool for young learners, with 9,574 common Chinese characters included!
desc.p2: Generate Tian Zi Ge and Mi Zi Ge practice sheets online, completely free. Tian Zi Ge is the simplest practice grid and is used in elementary Chinese textbooks to present new characters.
desc.p3: Elementary school — especially the early grades — is the critical period for learning to write Chinese characters. Generate practice sheets here to help children write characters correctly, build proper stroke-order habits, and lay a solid foundation for future Chinese learning.

tutorial.step1: For best print results, use Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome, with KaiTi (楷体) as the font
tutorial.step2: Enter the text to print without spaces — punctuation such as commas and periods is filtered out automatically
tutorial.step3: Choose your options, then click Generate Now
tutorial.step4: In the print dialog, enable Background graphics
